author: KikiMaloo
body:
Well, I'm looking for team :v
Information:
Well, I'm gonna rate my self from 1/10 in different facts about PvP.
At sword: 7/11
I weirdly can combo someone tbh, but I don't let them combo me as well xD (Some people can, obviously) 
Sword Skills:
CPS: 8 or 9
W tap: Yes
Strafe: kinda 
At bow: 8/10 
I'm pretty good when I have to shoot someone from a long distance, m even when they are moving constantly, My best has been 87 blocks or so, always critical arrows.
Bridging: 8/10
I'm good at bridging as well, not the best, but I definitely can do it.
Bridging Skills:
Normal: Of course
FastBridge: Yes
FastBridge upward: Yes
FastBridge Sideways: Yes 
Breezily: I'm working on it, my best I think has been 18 blocks, timing.
Breezily Upward: Yes
Breezily Sideways: HELL NO
Defending: 7/10
Defending is not my best thing honestly, but I know some good defenses, what I DO can do is be a tank defense.

Additional information: 
I speak English as third language, I'm not bad but I know if that could help if there's someone who speaks either Portuguese or Spanish in a English speaker team or viceversa. 

What about teamwork?
I have a little bit of Experience with teamworking, I've done it before, but with few players, right 2ooth and hundres? <3 :v


Hope some team pick me :D Good luck everyone!
